tools.name: gecici_wait_for_verification
tools.description: For authorized QA: wait for a new matching email and extract a code or HTTPS link in one call without returning the email body. Use since=inbox.createdAt for a fresh inbox, or the workflow start time in Unix milliseconds. Optional sender and subject filters apply together. Link mode requires an exac

tools.name: gecici_delete_inbox
tools.description: Permanently delete an active temporary inbox and its messages after a test. Requires that inbox's address and token. Cannot restore a deleted inbox; does not promise physical erasure from backups or logs.

tools.name: gecici_create_inbox
tools.description: Create a temporary inbox for an authorized development or QA workflow. Return its address, access token, and expiry; the token is required to read it.

tools.name: gecici_wait_for_otp
tools.description: Read an email verification code received by a temporary inbox owned with the supplied token. Use for authorized testing.

tools.name: gecici_wait_for_magic_link
tools.description: Read a verification or sign-in link received by a temporary inbox owned with the supplied token. Does not open the link.

tools.name: gecici_get_inbox_messages
tools.description: List messages in a temporary inbox owned with the supplied token, including senders, subjects, and extracted summaries.

tools.name: gecici_get_ai_summary
tools.description: Read the latest message summary from a temporary inbox owned with the supplied token.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gecici_create_inbox, gecici_wait_for_otp, gecici_wait_for_magic_link, gecici_get_inbox_messages, gecici_get_ai_summary · Private data: gecici_delete_inbox, gecici_create_inbox, gecici_wait_for_otp, gecici_wait_for_magic_link, gecici_get_inbox_messages, gecici_get_ai_summary · Public sink: gecici_wait_for_verification, gecici_wait_for_otp · Destructive: gecici_delete_inbox.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gecici_create_inbox, gecici_wait_for_otp, gecici_wait_for_magic_link, gecici_get_inbox_messages, gecici_get_ai_summary · Private data: gecici_delete_inbox, gecici_create_inbox, gecici_wait_for_otp, gecici_wait_for_magic_link, gecici_get_inbox_messages, gecici_get_ai_summary · Public sink: gecici_wait_for_verification, gecici_wait_for_otp · Destructive: gecici_delete_inbox

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
